column1: # schema 1 · every package a component installs (ADR 0039). Tab-separated; '-' is empty; no quotes.
# os: all, !<os> or a comma list of ubuntu, arch, omarchy (UM_OS). source: pm = the distro's package manager,
# one batch that must succeed; pm-try = a batch that may fail; code = the install script installs it (fallbacks,
# release binaries). pkg: the package manager's name when it differs. cmd: what the doctor checks, a|b = either.
# skip: yes = the user may leave it out (--skip-packages); no = the component needs it.
# when: - always; shell=fish = only when fish is the chosen shell (the screens filter on it).
